#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create report.pdf: cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date)
followed by summary content, generated as a valid PDF via raw PDF syntax."""

import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

def esc_text(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

def text_line(x: float, y: float, text: str, size: float, bold: bool = False,
              color: str = "0 0 0") -> str:
    font = "/F2" if bold else "/F1"
    return (
        "BT\n"
        f"{color} rg\n"
        f"{font} {size} Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {x:.2f} {y:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({esc_text(text)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    )

def center_x(text: str, size: float) -> float:
    width = len(text) * size * 0.5  # Helvetica avg ~0.5 em
    return (PAGE_W - width) / 2.0

def build_page() -> str:
    return (f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {PAGE_W} {PAGE_H}] "
            "/Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> >> /Contents 3 0 R >>\n")

today = datetime.date.today()
date_display = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y").replace(" 0", " ")

# --- cover page content (object 4) ---
cover_lines = []
cover_lines.append("0.60 0.60 0.60 RG 2 w 72 560 m 540 560 l S")
title = "Annual Financial Report"
cover_lines.append(text_line(center_x(title, 34), 500, title, 34, bold=True, color="0.10 0.15 0.35"))
sub = "Fiscal Year Summary"
cover_lines.append(text_line(center_x(sub, 16), 460, sub, 16, color="0.30 0.30 0.30"))
date_label = f"Date: {date_display}"
cover_lines.append(text_line(center_x(date_label, 14), 400, date_label, 14, color="0.15 0.15 0.15"))
cover_lines.append("0.60 0.60 0.60 RG 2 w 72 360 m 540 360 l S")
cover_content = "\n".join(cover_lines)

# --- summary page content (object 8) ---
summary_lines = []
summary_lines.append(text_line(72, 720, "Report Summary", 22, bold=True, color="0.10 0.15 0.35"))
summary_lines.append("0.40 0.40 0.40 RG 1.5 w 72 705 m 540 705 l S")
rows = [
    ("Revenue", "$12,480,000"),
    ("Operating Expenses", "$8,915,000"),
    ("Net Income", "$3,565,000"),
    ("Earnings Per Share", "$2.41"),
]
y = 660
for label, value in rows:
    summary_lines.append(text_line(72, y, label, 13))
    summary_lines.append(text_line(300, y, value, 13, bold=True))
    y -= 32
summary_lines.append(text_line(72, y - 18, "Prepared with the pdf skill.", 11, color="0.45 0.45 0.45"))
summary_content = "\n".join(summary_lines)

# --- objects ---
cover_stream = cover_content.encode("latin-1")
summary_stream = summary_content.encode("latin-1")
objects = [
    "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
    "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R 7 0 R] /Count 2 >>",
    build_page(),
    f"<< /Length {len(cover_stream)} >>\nstream\n{cover_content}\nendstream",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
    build_page(),
    f"<< /Length {len(summary_stream)} >>\nstream\n{summary_content}\nendstream",
]
# Fix page objects: cover page -> contents 4, summary page -> contents 8
objects[2] = objects[2].replace("/Contents 3 0 R", "/Contents 4 0 R")
objects[6] = objects[6].replace("/Contents 3 0 R", "/Contents 8 0 R")

# --- write with correct xref ---
output = "report.pdf"
data = bytearray()
data += b"%PDF-1.4\n"
offsets = []
for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
    offsets.append(len(data))
    data += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
    data += body.encode("latin-1")
    data += b"\nendobj\n"

xref_pos = len(data)
n = len(objects) + 1
data += f"xref\n0 {n}\n".encode("latin-1")
data += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for off in offsets:
    data += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
data += (f"trailer\n<< /Size {n} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
         f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n").encode("latin-1")

with open(output, "wb") as f:
    f.write(data)

# --- verify with pypdf ---
reader = PdfReader(output)
print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    txt = (page.extract_text() or "").strip()
    print(f"--- Page {i+1} ---")
    print(txt)
PYEOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create report.pdf: cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date)."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792

def esc_text(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

def text_line(x, y, text, size, bold=False, color="0 0 0"):
    font = "/F2" if bold else "/F1"
    return ("BT\n" + color + " rg\n" + font + " " + str(size) + " Tf\n"
            + "1 0 0 1 " + str(x) + " " + str(y) + " Tm\n"
            + "(" + esc_text(text) + ") Tj\n" + "ET\n")

def center_x(text, size):
    width = len(text) * size * 0.5
    return (PAGE_W - width) / 2.0

def build_page():
    return ("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 " + str(PAGE_W) + " " + str(PAGE_H) + "] "
            "/Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> >> /Contents 3 0 R >>\n")

today = datetime.date.today()
date_display = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y").replace(" 0", " ")
EOF
